description: Get the price the checkout will show a new customer, with any evening rate or public voucher it applies. Give `date` and `start_time` (from find_times) for the exact figure for that slot; without them you get the price for that length or job, and the evening rate is described separately. For weekly and every-2-weeks cleans it returns both the prepaid pack of visits (what the checkout starts on) and paying per visit.

frequency.description: Cleaning only: one-time, weekly, or bi-weekly (every 2 weeks).

hours.description: Cleaning only: visit length in hours (see find_services for the lengths we sell, e.g. 2, 3 or 4). When the customer has not said, use usual_hours on the cleaning entry of find_services (find_times and get_quote use it when hours is left out) and say it in your proposal; do not ask. Only if they ask how long their home needs, suggest from hours_by_home.

job_type.description: Every service but cleaning: the job, a job_type from the service's card (find_services with its code), e.g. general_service for aircon. A service quoted for each job has one: its quotation visit (quotation_visit) or consultation.

service.description: Required: the code of the service the customer asked for, from find_services (e.g. cleaning, aircon, sofa_cleaning). cleaning = home cleaning by the hour, a housekeeper's work (tidying, fridge, dishes, plants, vacuuming soft furnishings included); a deep, spring or move-out clean is a home clean with more hours, and a machine deep clean of one item is its own service. Every other service is booked by the job: give job_type and unit_count from its card.

start_time.description: Start time from find_times, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 19:30) or like 7:30 PM.

unit_count.description: Every service but cleaning: how many, in the service's own unit from its card (units, pieces, hours, panels...). 1 for a quotation visit or a consultation.

name: get_quote
title: Get the exact price
